Compliance means the investigation actually built a fault tree, stated a prediction before each test, and changed one variable — all properties of the reasoning content's meaning and quality, not of any artifact pattern.
Every clause (is this mine to fix, do I understand this code's purpose, is this abstraction asked-for) turns on intent and scope judgment about the change's meaning relative to the task.
